appDescription.message: Open HTML files stored in Google Drive as real web pages instead of raw source code.

emptyTitle.message: Preview an HTML file from Google Drive

emptyBody.message: Preview any .html file in Google Drive and it shows up as a web page right there. You can also paste a Drive file link below.

urlInvalid.message: That doesn't look like a Google Drive file link.

error_no_access.message: Google Drive didn't let this browser download the file. Make sure you're signed in with an account that can open it, and that the owner hasn't turned off downloading.

error_signed_out.message: You're signed out of Google. Sign in to Google Drive in this browser, then try again.

error_not_found.message: This file doesn't exist or has been deleted.

error_rate_limited.message: Google Drive is limiting downloads for this file right now. Wait a moment and try again.

error_too_large.message: This file is larger than 50 MB, which is too large to preview.

error_network.message: Couldn't reach Google Drive. Check your connection and try again.

error_http_error.message: Google Drive returned an unexpected response. Try again in a moment.
